govdocs-archive_org-nsia-PsychicPhenomen: This Time cover story — Boom Times on the Psychic Frontier, March — is a magazine feature. The 1970s loved the paranormal. The cover sold well. The file belongs to the cultural archive. The item is a fragment of press history.
china: Demetrius Boulger's history surveys China from ancient dynasties to the modern encounters with the West. Written by a knowledgeable Victorian observer, it covers emperors, wars, and customs in clear narrative. Though dated, it remains an interesting record of how the West once understood the Middle Kingdom.
